# shoehorn_governance_actions (Data Source)

Lists governance actions with optional filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Open critical governance actions
data "shoehorn_governance_actions" "critical" {
  status   = "open"
  priority = "critical"
}

output "critical_action_count" {
  value = data.shoehorn_governance_actions.critical.total
}

output "critical_action_entities" {
  value = [
    for a in data.shoehorn_governance_actions.critical.actions : a.entity_name
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `assigned_to` (String) Filter actions by assignee (user or team).
- `closed` (Boolean) Filter to only closed actions (resolved, dismissed, wont_fix).
- `entity_id` (String) Filter actions by entity ID.
- `overdue` (Boolean) Filter to only overdue actions.
- `priority` (String) Filter actions by priority (critical, high, medium, low).
- `source_type` (String) Filter actions by source type (scorecard, security, policy).
- `status` (String) Filter actions by status (open, in_progress, resolved, dismissed, wont_fix).

### Read-Only

- `actions` (Attributes List) The list of governance actions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actions))
- `total` (Number) Total number of actions matching the filters.

<a id="nestedatt--actions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `actions`

Read-Only:

- `assigned_to` (String) The user or team this action is assigned to.
- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) A description of the governance action.
- `due_date` (String) The computed due date based on SLA.
- `entity_id` (String) The entity ID this action is associated with.
- `entity_name` (String) The display name of the associated entity.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the governance action.
- `priority` (String) The priority level (critical, high, medium, low).
- `resolution_note` (String) A note explaining how the action was resolved.
- `sla_days` (Number) The SLA in days for resolving this action.
- `source_id` (String) The ID of the source that created this action.
- `source_type` (String) The source type that created this action.
- `status` (String) The action status.
- `title` (String) The title of the governance action.
- `updated_at` (String) The last update timestamp.
